name: Relightable Gaussian Codec Avatars
aliases: Relightable Gaussian head methods using FLAME rig
definition: A method that introduces relightable Gaussian avatars, supporting more diverse lighting conditions.
summary: Relightable Gaussian Codec Avatars reconstructs photorealistic 3D head avatars from monocular video, distinguishing itself by decoupling geometry and appearance to enable dynamic relighting under novel illumination.
